arbitrage.constraint_set: CRW 2020 Table 1: C1-C3 per expiry; C4, C5 and C6 (C6.1 a/b/c and the nearest-neighbour chord) between consecutive expiries only; see arbitrage.py

fit_set.rule: alternate strikes per expiry (even positions by strike), minus quotes the l1-BA repair moves outside their spread

essvi.description: eSSVI global surface (theta, psi, rho per expiry); Hendriks-Martini calendar and Gatheral-Jacquier butterfly conditions imposed; inverse half-spread weights

svi.description: raw SVI per expiry; Durrleman g(k) >= 0 on 241 points of k in [-1.5, 1] and Lee wing bounds; no calendar constraint between slices; inverse half-spread weights

universe_filters.note: identical to JointCalibrator.spx_surface_full; 0-6 DTE expiries are excluded, as in the calibrator
